tests.title: parses defaults, shorthand order, aliases, modes and folded plane flags into frozen steps
refuses out-of-range, non-integer, named, expression, timeline and unknown options explicitly
averages with truncation, keeps partial edge blocks, rounds blocks to the chroma grid and copies unselected planes
declares the native eight-bit formats in table order and plans one format-preserving stage
rejects unsupported layouts, budgets, malformed storage, bad settings and cancellation explicitly
matches native pixelize across formats, modes, block sizes, plane masks and odd sizes on the linear and graph planners
matches native pixelize rawvideo and framecrc CLI outputs on the linear, graph, stream, actor and timed paths
matches native replayed pixelize branches frame by frame through createReplayVideoExecution
matches native option acceptance and outputs for integer, hex, folded and out-of-range values, refusing expressions explicitly

details.compares: rawvideo bytes, native -vf vs compileVideoFilterChain and compileVideoFilterGraph (each run checked on both planners)
complete rawvideo and framecrc CLI outputs on linear, graph, stream, actor and timed paths (24 per path)
rawvideo bytes and pts, native -filter_complex vs createReplayVideoExecution
native option acceptance/rejection and rawvideo output

unsupported: av_expr expression values and named constants for width/height/mode/planes (e.g. w=2*3, w=max, h=4.5, planes=all)
native high-bit-depth and other formats outside the negotiation table (gray9-16, yuv410p/411p/440p, yuvj*, 9-16 bit YUV/GBR, yuva422p/444p, gbrap*)
H.264/MP4 framecrc input was not compared (linear path shared; size unchanged)

proposedContracts.name: matches native option acceptance and outputs for integer, hex, folded and out-of-range values, refusing expressions explicitly
proposedContracts.scope: 28 option strings: shorthand, aliases, hex, folded plane flags, out-of-range values, scoped refusals of expressions

notes: No shared edit beyond the two registry lines was needed.
Each CLI path case was shown to reach its intended executor by removing that path flag in turn: only that case failed, with the registry rejection for that path.
Setup durations: submodule 35 s, npm ci 8 s, reference:build 153 s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 66 s, baseline unit 67 s.
Baseline and final unit failures are identical: 13 tests in 6 files (FLAC artifacts unavailable, resample-checkpoint macOS golden digests).

Parse errors are VideoFilterParseError; kernel errors are plain Error because packages/avfilter/src/index.ts may not be edited to export a new error class; pixelizeVideoFrame and parsePixelizeOptions are reachable from the module but not from the public barrel.
